name: The Tangle
description: A copper forest home to trolls and sapient wolves, devastated by the fifth sun's emergence.

description_citations.text: "The Darksteel Eye". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drooge, the new Troll Leader, reveals the Kaldra Guardian can be summoned from pieces, the last held in the Vault of Whispers.
timeline.quote: He reveals they are two pieces necessary to summon a powerful avatar called the the Kaldra Guardian

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "The secret of the Kaldra Guardian". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The sapient wolf Al-Hayat joins the group and helps rescue Slobad.
timeline.quote: He agrees to join the group, and together they rescue Slobad.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Meeting Al-Hayat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The fifth sun dawns, evaporating the Kaldra avatar and devastating the Tangle.
timeline.quote: evaporating the Avatar and devastating the Tangle for miles in every direction

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Final confrontation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Slobad survive the blast, as do Memnarch and Malil.
timeline.quote: Slobad hobbles up to her, scorched and bruised but otherwise intact.

citation.text: "The Darksteel Eye", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The avatar pursues Glissa into the Tangle, destroying everything in its way.
timeline.quote: Kaldra's avatar relentlessly pursues Glissa into the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Memnarch turns Kaldra against them, and Glissa and Slobad flee to the Tangle and arrive at the Radix.
timeline.quote: Forced to retreat, Glissa and Slobad fled to the Tangle

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trolls of the Tangle sacrifice themselves to delay Kaldra.
timeline.quote: the trolls of the Tangle sacrificed themselves to delay Kaldra

citation.text: "Fifth Dawn (event)", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The shadow of the Mephidross spreads over the Tangle and the vampires' territory expands.
timeline.quote: As the shadow of the Mephidross spread over the Tangle, the vampires' territory expanded.

citation.text: Bleak Coven Vampires (Scars of Mirrodin, 2010), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trolls abduct Glissa, and Chunth says it was to protect her; she flees and learns the trolls were truthful.
timeline.quote: This troll called himself Chunth and explained that they had taken her to protect her.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa finds her home a charnel house, is wounded and captured by levelers, and is freed by Slobad.
timeline.quote: she found it a charnel house with levelers milling about.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Glissa is arrested for her parents' murder, cleared when levelers attack her trial, and learns her sister Lyese lives.
timeline.quote: As it turned out, her sister Lyese had not perished during the attack.

citation.text: "Glissa", section "Moons of Mirrodin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As depicted in the art of Blunt the Assault, nim attack Viridian elves in the Tangle without harming the unconcerned elves above.
timeline.quote: They must be nim, the necrogen-plagued undead of the Mephidross.

citation.text: "The Key Is Time". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: With Memnarch's soul traps destroyed, many Mirrodin inhabitants vanish and the elves' culture nearly collapses.
timeline.quote: After Memnarch's soul traps were destroyed, many of Mirrodin's original inhabitants disappeared from Mirrodin.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Under Ezuri the Viridian Resurgents embark on a mission to destroy the myr, vedalken and anything unnatural.
timeline.quote: Under the leadership of the charismatic Ezuri, they embark on a mission to destroy the myr, the vedalken, and anything else they deem unnatural.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Viridians reject the Tel-Jilad hierarchy and form voluntary brigades called gades.
timeline.quote: Once the Viridians rejected the hierarchy of the Tel-Jilad, they organized themselves into voluntary brigades.

citation.text: "The Nonhuman Cultures of Mirrodin". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Dec 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa thwarts Memnarch's plans, then disappears; the elves blame her for misfortunes and call her Glissa the Traitor.
timeline.quote: They called her Glissa the Traitor, and the name stuck.

citation.work: Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered
citation.text: "Phyrexia: The Strong and the Scattered". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Jan 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Koth sends partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the tunnels below Kuldotha.
timeline.quote: Koth sent partisans into the Tangle to bring survivors to the safe haven of the tunnels below Kuldotha.

citation.text: Koth's Courier (Mirrodin Besieged, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirran partisans create hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.
timeline.quote: The Mirran partisans created hundreds of patrol sentinels to divert Phyrexian assaults from the Tangle.

citation.text: Bladed Sentinel (Mirrodin Besieged, 2011), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Glissa builds a powerful faction by exploiting discontent, surviving assassination attempts with Vorinclex's help.
timeline.quote: surviving several assassination attempts with the help of Vorinclex—she constructed a powerful faction through cunning and strength.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa and Vorinclex pioneer accelerated growth and she creates crotus blooms in her gardens.
timeline.quote: She and Vorinclex pioneered a method of escalated growth using an amalgamation of tendon, fat, and brain matter.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Glissa warps crotus blooms into crotus beasts as her enforcers, and Phyrexian leadership, unaware of her plans, puts Vorinclex over the forest and assigns Glissa the compleation of local Mirrans.
timeline.quote: Over time, she warped the crotus blooms into crotus beasts, which become her enforcers.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Before the main attack, Glissa sends enforcer-beasts to kill in the Tangle and sets up nodes of control, so the forest is firmly hers when Phyrexians emerge.
timeline.quote: Even before Phyrexia's attack on the surface began, Glissa sent her enforcer-beasts on killing missions into the Tangle.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Phyrexia emerges and the Sylvok are hit hardest; over half die in the first wave after Glissa's arrival.
timeline.quote: Over half were killed in the first wave following Glissa's arrival in the Tangle.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ezuri leads many Viridian elves into hiding and builds a small resistance in the treetops.
timeline.quote: Under Ezuri's leadership, however, many of the Viridian elves were able to hide and escape the Phyrexian onslaught.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After the Fifth Dawn, the elves retreat into the trees in fear and begin to turn on each other.
timeline.quote: As a result, the elves retreated inward, taking refuge in natural niches inside the massive trees of the Tangle.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Ezuri emerges as a leader, rallying the Viridians and giving them new purpose.
timeline.quote: A young elf named Ezuri began to unify the Viridians and direct them toward productive tasks.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Melira is abandoned in the Tangle as an infant for her fully organic body and saved by the last troll.
timeline.quote: But she was saved by an unlikely hero: the last troll living on Mirrodin.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thrun finds Melira, adopts her and teaches her Mirrodin's past and survival skills.
timeline.quote: Thrun adopted her, instilling in the girl the knowledge of Mirrodin's distant past

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thrun realizes that Melira is immune to the Spore and to phyresis, and may be the key to saving Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: Melira just might be the key to saving all of Mirrodin.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: After Glissa alters the Tangle, Ezuri gathers the remaining elves and Sylvok in the treetops and joins the resistance.
timeline.quote: He soon led them to join the resistance movement for Mirrodin

citation.text: "Ezuri", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Half the Sylvok disappeared in the Vanishing, and Benzir became de facto leader.
timeline.quote: Half the Sylvok population disappeared in the Vanishing

citation.text: "Sylvok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Benzir's vision quest led to animal worship among the Sylvok.
timeline.quote: This has led to a culture of animal worship among the Sylvok

citation.text: "Sylvok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Phyrexia's advance, the Tangle is infected by lamina fungus, rotting the ground.
timeline.quote: the Tangle was infected by the growth of lamina

citation.text: "Tangle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Phyrexians build nine layers on Mirrodin, the Tangle is transplanted to the fourth layer as the Hunter's Maze.
timeline.quote: the Tangle was transplanted to the fourth layer, becoming the Hunter's Maze

citation.text: "Tangle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: the Rey-Goor, which is the name of a part of the Tangle that merges with the Mephidross

citation.text: "The Key Is Time". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: He rules the Tangle but hides in Tel-Jilad.
relations.quote: A native Phyrexian beast known as Vorinclex rules the Tangle

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: De facto leader of the Tangle.
relations.quote: Although Glissa is the de facto leader of the Tangle, she refuses to identify herself as such.

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to New Phyrexia: The Vicious Swarm". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: They made dwellings in the tree-like spires.
relations.quote: The elves made their dwellings in the tree-like metal spires here

citation.text: "Tangle", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
